why: Multiple post-snapshot papers prove Vaught's conjecture for specific restricted classes of theories (discretely ordered structures 2024, Ehrenfeucht theories via 'Scott Analysis below the Vaught Ordinal' 2026, partial orders with finite lexicographic decomposition 2026), settling cases of the general conjecture while it remains open overall.

found.title: Vaught's conjecture for theories of discretely ordered structures
found.note: Proves the conjecture (continuum-many countable models) for theories with a definable infinite discrete linear order; v3 dated 2024.

found.title: Scott Analysis below the Vaught Ordinal
found.note: Proves the omega-Vaught's conjecture for Ehrenfeucht theories, per search summary.

found.title: Vaught's Conjecture and Theories of Partial Order Admitting a Finite Lexicographic Decomposition
found.note: Proves the conjecture for a class of partial-order theories; not read.

found.title: The number of countable models of first-order theories (Pillay, Tanović)
found.note: 2025 paper on the topic of counting countable models; relevance to Vaught's conjecture not confirmed beyond title/topic.
